subject.title: Telegram: unquarantine skipped sticker e2e tests

question: Should Telegram still require a dedicated static WEBP sticker metadata e2e case, or is the current resolver/cache/context coverage sufficient to close this issue?
rationale: Current main and `v2026.6.11` only cover the cache-refresh half of the original unskip criteria, and the protected labels route the remaining coverage sufficiency choice to maintainers.

options.title: Require static WEBP e2e
options.body: Keep this issue open until a deterministic first-seen static WEBP sticker metadata e2e is added and proven in the requested CI lanes.

options.title: Accept current coverage
options.body: Close this issue only after a maintainer states that resolver, context, and cache-refresh tests cover the risk well enough without the original e2e title.

recommendation.title: Require static WEBP e2e
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a deterministic first-seen static WEBP sticker metadata e2e is added and proven in the requested CI lanes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the stabilization PR that quarantined the tests and created this follow-up boundary.
